articles.summary: 24/7 Wall St.: Simpson Manufacturing: The Housing Recovery Play That’s Buying Back Shares. Simpson Manufacturing (SSD) trades at $187.78 after a 16.5% surge to start 2026, putting it within striking distance of its 52-week high of $197.12. The company spent $100 million buying back shares in 2024 while earnings fell 13%. That’s the tension: Is management buying low on a housing recovery, or throwing good money after bad? ... articles.summary: CNW Group: GracoRoberts Acquires Sky Mart to Accelerate Latin American Expansion, Anchored by Miami Hub.
